title: सार्वजनिक विद्यालयका शिक्षकहरूप्रति विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समिति र विद्यार्थीको व्यवहार अध्ययन Saarbajanik Bidhyalayaka Shikshakharuprati bidhyalaya byabasthaapan samiti ra bidhyaarthiko byabahaar adhyayan
nepali: यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य सार्वजनिक विद्यालयका शिक्षकप्रति विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समिति र विद्यार्थीकाव्यवहारको अध्ययन गर्नु रहेको छ । गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचामा आधारित यस लेख सप्तरी जिल्लाको खडक नगरपालिकामा रहेका २ ओटा माध्यमिक विद्यालयहरूमा केन्द्रित छ । उद्देश्यमूलक नमुना छनोट विधिद्वारा २ जना प्रधानाध्यापक, २ जना विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समितिका अध्यक्ष, २ जना अभिभावक, ४ जना शिक्षक र २ जना छात्र सहभागीका रूपमा लिइएका छन् । सहभागीहरूसँग अन्तरवार्ता छलफल र प्रश्नावलीद्वारा आवश्यक तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । अन्तरवार्तालाई टान्सक्राइब गरेर कोड निर्माण गरिएको छ । कोडका आधारमा थेमको निर्माणगरी थेमाटिक विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । अध्ययनअनुसार प्रधानाध्यापक र सहकर्मी शिक्षकहरूको एक आपसमा व्यवहार सद्भावपूर्ण रहेको पाइयो । साथै सामूहिक प्रयास, समन्वय र सहकार्यमा विद्यालयका योजना निर्माण, निर्णय रसमस्याहरू समाधान गर्ने गरेको पाइयो । विद्यालय व्यवस्थापन समितिका अध्यक्ष र निरीक्षकहरूले शिक्षकहरूसँग प्रजातान्त्रिक व्यवहार अवलम्बन गरेका साथै अभिभावक र विद्यार्थीहरूले पनि सकारात्मक व्यवहार गरेको पाइयो तर शिक्षण पेसाको गरिमा र प्रतिष्ठा दिनानुदिन घट्दै गएको अवस्थामा विद्यालयमा शिक्षकप्रति गरिने व्यवहार थप सम्मानजनक, सबल र समृद्ध बनाउन पेसागत र विषयगत रूपमा दक्ष, योग्य शिक्षक शिक्षण पेसामा प्रवेश गराउन शिक्षक नियुक्तिका स्पष्ट आधारहरूको निर्माण र कार्यान्वयन, विद्यालय तथा विश्वविद्यालयलाई राजनीतिक हस्तक्षेप मुक्त क्षेत्र, पेसामा संलग्नहरूका लागि आर्थिक स्वतन्त्रताको अवस्था सृजना हुने किसिमका नीतिगत व्यवस्था गर्न आवश्यक रहेको देखिन्छ। शिक्षकहरूप्रति सद्भाव र विश्वासको वातावरण निर्माण गर्नका लागि शिक्षकहरू विषयगत रूपमा दक्ष, लगनशील र जिम्मेवार भई आफ्नो पेसामा समर्पित हुन सकेमा सरोकारवालाहरूले शिक्षकलाई गर्ने व्यवहारमा सकार ात्मक दृष्टिकोणको विकास गर्न सघाउ पु¥याउने देखिन्छ ।
american_english: The primary objective of this study is to examine the behavior of school management committees and students toward public school teachers. Based on a qualitative research design, this article is focused on 2 secondary schools located in Khadak Municipality of Saptari District. Through a purposive sampling method, 2 principals, 2 school management committee chairpersons, 2 parents, 4 teachers, and 2 students were selected as participants. The necessary data was collected from participants through interviews, discussions, and questionnaires. The interviews were transcribed to generate codes. Based on the codes, themes were created and thematic analysis was performed. According to the study, behavior between the principals and peer teachers was found to be cordial. Furthermore, formulating school plans, making decisions, and resolving problems were found to be carried out through collective effort, coordination, and collaboration. School management committee chairpersons and inspectors were found to adopt democratic behavior toward teachers, and parents and students also exhibited positive behavior; however, in a situation where the dignity and prestige of the teaching profession are declining day by day, to make the treatment of teachers in schools more respectful, strong, and enriching, it appears necessary to establish and implement clear criteria for teacher appointments to bring professionally and subject-wise competent, qualified teachers into the teaching profession, declare schools and universities areas free from political interference, and make policy arrangements that create conditions of financial independence for those engaged in the profession. In order to build an atmosphere of goodwill and trust toward teachers, if teachers can be subject-wise competent, diligent, and responsible while remaining dedicated to their profession, it appears this will help develop a positive perspective in the behavior exhibited toward teachers by stakeholders.

australian_english: The primary objective of this study is to examine the behaviour of school management committees and students towards public school teachers. Based on a qualitative research design, this paper is focused on 2 secondary schools located in Khadak Municipality of Saptari District. Through a purposive sampling method, 2 principals, 2 school management committee presidents, 2 parents, 4 teachers, and 2 students were selected as participants. The necessary data was gathered from participants through interviews, discussions, and questionnaires. The interviews were transcribed to generate codes. Based on the codes, themes were established and thematic analysis was performed. According to the study, behaviour between the principals and peer teachers was found to be collegial. In addition, formulating school plans, making decisions, and resolving problems were found to be carried out through collective effort, coordination, and collaboration. School management committee presidents and inspectors were found to adopt democratic behaviour towards teachers, and parents and students also showed positive behaviour; however, in a situation where the dignity and standing of the teaching profession are slipping day by day, to make the treatment of teachers in schools more respectful, solid, and uplifting, it looks necessary to establish and implement clear criteria for teacher appointments to bring professionally and subject-wise competent, qualified teachers into the teaching profession, declare schools and universities areas free from political interference, and make policy arrangements that create conditions of financial independence for those engaged in the profession. In order to build an atmosphere of goodwill and trust towards teachers, if teachers can be skilled in their subjects, hardworking, and responsible while staying dedicated to their profession, it looks likely to help develop a positive outlook in the behaviour exhibited towards teachers by stakeholders.

Based on a qualitative research design, this paper is focused on 2 secondary schools located in Khadak Municipality of Saptari District. Through a purposive sampling method, 2 principals, 2 school council chairpersons, 2 parents, 4 teachers, and 2 students were selected as participants. The necessary data was gathered from participants through interviews, discussions, and questionnaires. The interviews were transcribed to generate codes. Based on the codes, themes were created and thematic analysis was performed. According to the study, behaviour between the principals and colleague teachers was found to be pretty cordial and friendly. Furthermore, formulating school plans, making decisions, and sorting out problems were found to be carried out through collective effort, coordination, and collaboration. School council chairpersons and inspectors were found to adopt democratic behaviour towards teachers, and parents and students also showed positive behaviour; however, in a situation where the dignity and standing of the teaching profession are slipping day by day, to make the treatment of teachers in schools more respectful, solid, and uplifting, it looks necessary to establish and implement clear criteria for teacher appointments to bring professionally and subject-wise competent, qualified teachers into the teaching profession, declare schools and universities areas free from political interference, and make policy arrangements that create conditions of financial independence for those engaged in the profession. In order to build an atmosphere of goodwill and trust towards teachers, if teachers can be skilled in their subjects, hardworking, and responsible while staying dedicated to their profession, it looks sure to help develop a positive perspective in how stakeholders treat teachers.
